meta.name: handoff
meta.description: Compact the current conversation into a handoff document for another agent to pick up.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将当前对话压缩为交接文档供其他智能体接手
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多个智能体之间传递上下文
copy.tagline_en: Compact the current conversation into a handoff document for another agent
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to pass context between multiple agents

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会把当前对话压缩成一份交接文档，保存到电脑临时文件夹，供另一个 AI 继续工作。文档会包含建议调用的技能，并隐藏敏感信息。
howto.when: 当你需要把当前任务交给另一个 AI 继续处理时，可以要求 Claude 生成交接文档。

say.text: 帮我生成一份交接文档，下一个会话要接着做这个项目。
say.note: Claude 会压缩对话并保存文档。

say.text: 把当前对话整理成交接文档，下一轮重点讨论代码优化。
say.note: Claude 会根据你的重点调整文档内容。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude compresses the current conversation into a handoff document, saves it to the OS temp folder, and includes suggested skills for the next agent. Sensitive info is redacted.
howto.when_en: When you need to hand off the current task to another agent, ask Claude to generate a handoff document.

say_en.text: Generate a handoff document for the next session to continue this project.
say_en.note: Claude will compress the conversation and save the document.

say_en.text: Summarize this conversation as a handoff, focusing on code optimization next.
say_en.note: Claude tailors the document to your focus.
